It's official: Matt Larkin – the most extreme Republican in the primary – will be taking on Kim in November. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48801254/359650467/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTRlNDY0MC01YTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o8U_lDtHMJmcPfalsw59zJOIn75SCjjfHHYVzQOTbZs=&emci=e3f7747a-5514-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=394e4640-5a14-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter,

The results of the primary in Washington's 8th District are in, and it's official:**Matt Larkin – the most extreme Republican in the primary – will be taking on Kim in November.**

Here's a few things you need to know about Matt Larkin:

1️⃣ **Larkin is a Trump Republican** – In 2020, Larkin said "I love all of the things the President is doing... It's nice to see a President not care." Larkin even refused to say whether Joe Biden's victory in 2020 was legitimate.

2️⃣ **Larkin is unapologetically anti-choice** – Larkin celebrated the end of Roe v. Wade, going so far as to say he was the “only pro-life candidate” in the Republican primary race. Larkin even supports banning abortion in cases of rape and incest.

3️⃣ **Larkin doesn't even live in our district** – Larkin has focused his campaign on issues in Seattle because he doesn't even live in WA-08!

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0589%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=TxsqJslmvDv5caPcBhyshA&sysid=1)
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30550%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F%2fPZMIc1Crd4eEtuwjR6gA&sysid=1)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30551%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ulz55NwJxHHkE%2fi8qAIRzQ&sysid=1)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30552%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=obl%2fW1%2bfHcojHVa1IcFUyQ&sysid=1)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30553%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=i7qJIRK8Mj4ph7afHVfqsg&sysid=1)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30554%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iVyrYgTFnKJ5MN208S%2bl%2bA&sysid=1)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30565%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ofrW3dXKlo6dMEa8b0IjzQ&sysid=1)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30566%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D87TZGTZvuJwj2KXWD9rPg&sysid=1)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT’s events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30567%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=J%2f%2fC4hUGXJe3gioEc%2bZulA&sysid=1)

What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30568%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=o7JkUaCe7w98dKmoyjRvIg&sysid=1)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30562%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=x5ap1xaUOcRE7qc3mAHipg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30563%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=20orJIYCh0j36z28bbUNWw&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30564%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p2wdDq2kR37N8IVP6a8Izw&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30575%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YRNfyDEI7bYe4SpjTj7rlg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30576%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jCbifa%2bKZsGzJe%2b9E3tFDw&sysid=1)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

We’ve been made aware of an opportunity for people to earn a [certificate in Election Administration](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._P7XLTHIPVvQy_kJaI7A) through an online course offered by the University of Minnesota. We wanted to share it with you. The [deadline](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to apply is August 15, 2022, so if you’re interested, you’ll need to apply right away! Now, this program is from a liberal point of view, for liberals, but we think it would be beneficial to have patriots go through the course to see what they’re saying and teaching. It would also help our election integrity movement if we had patriots certified in Election Administration, because it’s not hard to imagine the left trying to require credentials like this to work elections someday. For instance, they describe in a session titled, “Election Accuracy,” how they see elections: _Local and state election officials in the United States — who work hard to run accurate and secure voting processes — are finding that facts are not a sufficient defense of their election outcomes. Despite the rigorous steps that protect voter registration, ballot distribution, election systems and vote counting, conspiracy theories are undermining the public's trust in this most basic act of a democracy. To combat this problem, experts from around the nation analyze the problem to provide actionable steps so election administrators can go on the offense to manage communications before, during and after an election._ While it could be frustrating to sit through a program with such a left-wing bias, it would provide a treasure trove of information about their plans and how they see the world of elections in America. If you end up applying, we’d love to hear, so please let us know! And feel free to pass this on to people you know who might be interested!
---

body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Mat
[](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9f13ccb10f8c4b8984bf4e4a2981d69c&_e=ZNx670csrl9COYvWHfxiIyonv6691-qPEqCghSlVqu0j0OaX1apfpmIMMgGUNkV4nmNd7xMq7K2juedyTzWoKHMvmojsb7DXkWpUzN26DLoR23T5T1RvlsEYjyZO2wbA8jfRn0jzmGxUAATrqK2z56MwnVfAmwBz5vKlHGQ_oeuZMLnVTD5Qw7v9G77qGJTMCU_jo0K9DESy6V4jHM1hmAQ-iM5xmdBUgJ2cIDs7Nq1BdXBoIo8w2xUyy2VqwNExaNoaDqxfaUjmhqjA80eKm89yTyEacfKZhWJmjPPNGGymfDurDNYG4L9msZztsefvyJ1JGnrV1-LZwJ7QMMiscr8xLvq4DTU1wGPfBAmi724%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9f13ccb10f8c4b8984bf4e4a2981d69c&_e=ZNx670csrl9COYvWHfxiIyonv6691-qPEqCghSlVqu0j0OaX1apfpmIMMgGUNkV4nmNd7xMq7K2juedyTzWoKHMvmojsb7DXkWpUzN26DLoR23T5T1RvlsEYjyZO2wbA8jfRn0jzmGxUAATrqK2z54aKWFM9qr4b7FfcRm5wyfyl5G_DUzwmqn38C0mHVm3Yl6mFqGSbK3hJggnioUHHnySkmSELJK991SYmbr0EGIXtEJnIhDhEtWAHKxdZfH4WMGMX7Yyr6_zwXJljWDVuag5VYhdbk-wMwdKZSjt05KnjMjRmDRFwO5bqhiR8fLFIED49q3xFMPNy7L4ocDXA00MJc-snPEP1bsyhoo9bJ_c%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

clean_body: I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Mat Friend, I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -Black Lives Matter. Now, I know what you’re thinking... What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis? I ask, “what about them is influential?!” This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities? No. They aren’t, but BLM is. BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations. I saw the hypocrisy long ago. That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. BLEXIT is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support. How I Started BLEXIT I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans. With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me. This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever. I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM. Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others. Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes. BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law. BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them. BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character. BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. Here’s how you can help: I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities. This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter. BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: HOW BLEXIT Works Step One: We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods. Step Two: We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy. We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time. Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses. As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them. Step Three: Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media. BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families. Step Four: We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities. What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a “DO” tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods. Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man. We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods. So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. People ask me, “What does BLEXIT mean?” It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. “If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.” - Candace Owens We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end. Thank you, Brandon Tatum Co-Founder BLEXIT Foundation Sent to Defend the Constitution subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Mat
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=26a195ca8b87486da1a7da9981c9a7a7&_e=IpKEGB0dWW9JbHhvj1RI918_tSJXBvpynfVxrL8uldXLNc-d2hRNkIxP725nh5Pn9ZtKg6uEwnJb4Ck-G_Fiv-RwxuQQet4SAqKcW7Q9FxlX-n7I65AJiQi1AA-7GzDL2ciwuV0DeE2ZJcfHYv9VgV-pnnDK4i8JMhdqx5Gba1aE-mC2SgZPVHflAnMZqlr7rJtbcjI8LZn4jl6REzQPxHu4N_LnlDo1pcclv57qmBfK3zwqkAP_H83VVlXhGaj-1IE--JL-hjf6IxVIhtDehvK8DL6dj5FDz4EUKlXbX356Ze7PiPtmQI2FElYy19Ehkuj06DSad8k4OvZ_buT3QVT6_TF8L79wpGwqs5ipOic%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=26a195ca8b87486da1a7da9981c9a7a7&_e=IpKEGB0dWW9JbHhvj1RI918_tSJXBvpynfVxrL8uldXLNc-d2hRNkIxP725nh5Pn9ZtKg6uEwnJb4Ck-G_Fiv-RwxuQQet4SAqKcW7Q9FxlX-n7I65AJiQi1AA-7GzDL2ciwuV0DeE2ZJcfHYv9VgZyUlGLu-LHLNx3e1HgInCFC5jtVAuRfGZILeLuM8OvrohG4sI5MhVYDI1hJdC3Xy5eaIs5RVx3nTvQRuSamnwcVXGIavqloGg9ceQ-vK0PFTfH0jF2swUKu5VfCR7y20726kNKRNmn0oeVwrTBqcxVFzT-bW7zVxQv0MPR78p0k8lpg0mjAU6Q28OgFtzlCA-ATZk7OwxOxNkhHYM18bsA%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=26a195ca8b87486da1a7da9981c9a7a7&_e=IpKEGB0dWW9JbHhvj1RI918_tSJXBvpynfVxrL8uldXLNc-d2hRNkIxP725nh5Pn9ZtKg6uEwnJb4Ck-G_Fiv-RwxuQQet4SAqKcW7Q9FxlX-n7I65AJiQi1AA-7GzDL2ciwuV0DeE2ZJcfHYv9VgX8iLfEj-xvJCNX1TYWeS7ayzFmS-77LuANBIYbR7rLbyfTRexl140GfclZgZ55WBg4GPNjcvIBD53vDDnxKPjbyN7-rjM7g2a0wxEa4UGbWGI9OnhjUhitmMHVLUO7CUUUUnMJ1V6sEsoIosP4T7ZR-YnQO7ZqqRTU050ARHUl5q_aoY66Qcx0p_ZZthfZkqDH0zkgx6mE73lYDqE1LAY8%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=26a195ca8b87486da1a7da9981c9a7a7&_e=IpKEGB0dWW9JbHhvj1RI918_tSJXBvpynfVxrL8uldXLNc-d2hRNkIxP725nh5Pn9ZtKg6uEwnJb4Ck-G_Fiv-RwxuQQet4SAqKcW7Q9FxlX-n7I65AJiQi1AA-7GzDL0d0IC1AD3fonT4_97rANF38FG5afqeOVeobim7iTkPbFBA-7Tn-Gr4PAnfn2KA9yc7Og9CHxOFq0ArDqK_UbnE8ys1DVm9Hbs-kP9_1qmPFKhCT2N70FaOOzH5haxdWAAvmCyNTCKQAFXAc4D3jyfpf5ZiFQ4Wr31BbOHxMIUbkdyXU4BmsR3dHIY1E7M-4L-6gOrdp7lrUA5r1k4V7Cs4Zfe-t4Wi3ZR8iWjkCVVfw%3D)

Every dollar you can spare will help us build the strongest grassroots operation to defeat Rubio, flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48813345/359702095/-74008005?refcode=20220805_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWFjZGNiOC1jNzE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sb-QOWCAozzubJaO1Ir_qYgjp2dwUenSUvTaVvBw8VY=) Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. **So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine.** The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. [**I stand on the side of our democratic institutions, on the side of everyday working Floridians – but I need your help to win this race. Will you split a contribution of $20 or more to Serve America and me to defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48813346/359702097/-74008005?refcode=20220805_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWFjZGNiOC1jNzE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sb-QOWCAozzubJaO1Ir_qYgjp2dwUenSUvTaVvBw8VY=) In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. clean_body: | | | = Friend, I'm Val Demings, and I'm running for the U.S. Senate to defeat Marco Rubio and win better, stronger leadership for the people of Florida. Just 10,033 votes (0.2 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: I cannot win this without you. = Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine. The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice. = In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. Because when your friends and neighbors put their trust in you to be their voice, you work for them – and that's just not what we're seeing from Sen. Rubio. But it's only together that we'll have a shot at winning – so here's what I'm counting on: 6,112 donations, before 11:59 p.m. tonight. body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.

Peter,

Florida is the freest state in the nation because we reject the wokeness that has taken over other states and institutions. While blue states and corporate America fully embrace this mind virus, Florida has stood strong against ideologies that seek to incite division and hate amongst our citizens.

You don’t need me to tell you that our country is heading down a dangerous path. The Democrat Machine is infecting our nation from the inside out, and the root of it all is a woke and destructive ideology.

This incessant need to control every aspect of our lives and force one point of view on us all or risk being “canceled” is a mind virus that is destroying any institution that it gets hold of.

We’ve seen this in all corners of our lives, but most egregiously in our education system. Other states have bent the knee to the woke mob, injecting Critical Race Theory and gender ideologies into our youngest and most impressionable kids — but I can tell you in the state of Florida, we've drawn a very clear line in the sand.We've said that the purpose of our education system is to educate our kids, not to indoctrinate our kids.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2b958e664b9d9cc6512dc37d0861299553ce13fca2c8dcf266143706e0bab5c28eadd972b91470961900fced293b0ecad2f6295deb85e3c8ff486714d53eddc3
EDUCATION NOT INDOCTRINATION >>>

The Left wants to use CRT to distort American history in an effort to delegitimize our Founding Fathers and the principles of this country with the goal of replacing it with their Leftist ideology.

You and I both know that will be a disaster for our society and our country, Peter. We know this woke ideology is rejected by the overwhelming majority of Americans. In Florida, we reject that.

The truth is this woke agenda has injected itself into the inner workings of elite institutions and poisoned their entire frameworks.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2b958e664b9d9cc6512dc37d0861299553ce13fca2c8dcf266143706e0bab5c28eadd972b91470961900fced293b0ecad2f6295deb85e3c8ff486714d53eddc3
REJECT THE WOKE AGENDA >>>

We see it at the universities. We see it in corporate America. We even see it in the military. They're trying to take the basic structure and purpose for these organizations and turn them into parasites for the Democrat Machine. Corporate media and Big Tech long ago abandoned their purpose to inform and connect people and transformed into the censorship arm of the Democrat Party, stifling dissent, stifling conservative voices, and silencing any and all points of view that differ from their own.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2b958e664b9d9cc6512dc37d0861299553ce13fca2c8dcf266143706e0bab5c28eadd972b91470961900fced293b0ecad2f6295deb85e3c8ff486714d53eddc3
PROTECT FLORIDA FROM THE DEMOCRAT MACHINE >>>

In Florida, we’ve rejected these woke ideologies seeking to further divide us rather than unite us. We’re standing up to the Democrat Machine, to the legacy media, and to woke corporations. We’re sending a strong message while doing it: your lies might fly in California, but they will not be tolerated in the state of Florida.

Democrats have taken note of our Freedom Agenda, and they’ve made Florida their number one target for elections this November. They know we are the greatest threat to their war on democracy because we are the strongest soldiers in the battle for liberty and freedom.

I will never back down from the fight to Keep Florida Free. As we get closer to November, I need to know I can count on your support to protect our great state.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2b958e664b9d9cc6f428a551c645a73b664e8a727c6a16466acebfdcba1b44fa71132347f355fd59b533938a66d72dbc0d38098f7e48b3e82e7fca3a5058f8ba
The battle has only just begun, are you with me?

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2b958e664b9d9cc6512dc37d0861299553ce13fca2c8dcf266143706e0bab5c28eadd972b91470961900fced293b0ecad2f6295deb85e3c8ff486714d53eddc3
KEEP FLORIDA FREE >>>

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

body:
https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
Today is the first day of the General Election and I am excited to make my case to the voters of the new 5th Congressional District. This race has a clear contrast between my “Freedom for Families” agenda and our opponent’s allegiance to Trump’s extreme MAGA agenda.
I believe in fixing real problems for families like fighting inflation, lowering the cost of prescription drugs, healthcare, and child care. Importantly, I believe families should have the freedom to make personal healthcare decisions — without government interference. We’re focused on finding common ground and I will stand up every day to fight against efforts to marginalize women, families, and our democracy.
We’re building a campaign to block the GOP’s plan for a national ban on abortion and their irresponsible effort to raise taxes on 75 million working families and small business owners.
We need to build an economy that strengthens the middle class, from the middle out and bottom up. That means we need to reinforce Social Security and Medicare for our seniors, invest in great public schools, students and teachers, and legalize cannabis so we stop wasting tax dollars.
The stakes of this election could not be more clear for the future of our state and our country.
We are in an extremely strong position headed toward November. We have raised nearly $400,000 in just four months while my opponent just stumbled out of a brutal and expensive Republican primary.
We can hold onto the 5th Congressional seat but we can’t do it without your help. Will you chip in today to help kick off our General Election plan? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
Thanks so much for your support!
Heidi

The stakes of this election could not be more clear for the future of our state and our country. We are in an extremely strong position headed toward November. We can hold onto the 5th Congressional seat but we can’t do it without your help. Will you chip in today to help kick off our General Election plan? [] Thanks so much for your support! body:
As we get closer to Election Day, you’re going to hear a lot of claims about my record here in Colorado.

Folks — as we get closer to Election Day, you’re going to hear a lot of claims about my record here in Colorado. I’m very proud of what we’ve gotten done these last four years, but I also know my opponents are trying to win this election by distorting my record and making misleading claims. **Fortunately, team, we have the facts on our side. So here are some important facts about how we’re working to save money for Colorado families:**
* We’ve closed tax loopholes that were benefiting corporations and special interests — and cut taxes for Colorado families and small businesses.
* We lowered property taxes, got rid of state tax on seniors’ social security, and made it $1 to start a business.
* This spring, we cut red tape and made historic investments to create more affordable housing in Colorado.
* We’re about to send every Colorado a $750 tax rebate in the next couple weeks.
* Starting next year, preschool in Colorado will be free for every four-year-old — saving parents with preschoolers an average of $4,300.

Team, here’s the thing: Coloradans have a lot going on in their lives, so we can’t expect folks to just know off the top of their heads everything we’ve gotten done. We need to make our case to voters — and make it enthusiastically in every corner of the state. **[Despite the attacks we’re facing, I am running for re-election proudly on my record, and I would be honored to have your help in this fight, folks. body:
Peter —
Last month, the HuffPost published an article on this race, and the title speaks for itself:
“In Race To Face DeSantis, It’s Ms. 'Something New’ Versus Mr. Seventh Time Around”
Charlie Crist has run for statewide office SEVEN TIMES — and he hasn’t won statewide elected office as a Democrat ONCE.
He knows how the game is played. He knows all the right things to say and all the right hands to shake. But he clearly doesn’t know (or care) what Floridians actually want from our elected officials.
We want a Governor who’s ALWAYS been pro-choice. We want a Governor who hasn’t taken a PENNY from the NRA. And we want a candidate who’s won statewide as a Democrat.
In short, we want something new. And Nikki Fried is the ONLY candidate in this race who can bring something new to Florida.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0805 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0805]
Peter,
On Tuesday, the people of Kansas voted overwhelmingly to protect the right to an abortion in their state.
Protecting women’s reproductive rights in a red state like Kansas is a big deal – and proves that Democrats, Independents, and Republicans alike are fired up and ready to fight against their rights being taken away by far-right extremists on the Supreme Court and in Congress.
The election here in Georgia’s First District isn’t just about fighting for reproductive freedom; it’s about fighting back against Buddy Carter’s extremist attacks on women.
Buddy doesn’t just want to take away the right for a woman to make her own reproductive healthcare choices – he is co-sponsoring a bill that completely criminalizes abortion, even in cases of rape, incest, or if the mother’s life is at risk.
The bill is so extreme that it would ban some forms of birth control, limit IVF, and eliminate certain cancer treatments.
His attacks against women & their rights don’t stop there.
Not only is Buddy trying to force women to carry their rapists' babies, but he also bragged about voting for a bill that limited funds for rape kit testing and voted against the bipartisan Violence Against Women Act that protects domestic abuse victims.
From day one of this campaign, I have promised to stand up for a woman’s right to choose and make her own health care decisions.
Protecting the right to an abortion is not only the right thing to do; it is what the majority of voters support. Politicians need to stay out of private health care decisions.
On November 8th, we need to defeat Buddy Carter and his extremism. The lives of our mothers, daughters, wives, sisters, and neighbors are at stake.
If a win for women’s rights can happen in Kansas, it can happen here in Georgia too.
If you’re ready to help us win in November, please consider contributing to our campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0805]
I appreciate your support,

Friend -- 1,327,847. That's the number of voters Country First reached in Michigan during our "Month of Action" ahead of the August 2nd primary election. In state House and Senate districts where a Republican is all but guaranteed to win in November, we focused our efforts on turning out Democrats, Independents, and disaffected Republicans to vote in the GOP primary to defeat Ultra MAGA candidates (many of whom were endorsed by Trump) who otherwise would have won. _**And we were victorious in 9 out of 10 races!**_ Now you may be wondering, what does a congressman from Illinois care about Michigan? And the answer is simple: Michigan had become ground zero for Ultra MAGA's war on democracy, with a startling number of candidates who participated in January 6th. Their plan was to take over the state legislature and ensure Michigan's 2024 electoral college votes went to their preferred candidate. And while those candidates and their supporters haven't gone anywhere, we know one thing: Democracy is a little safer now that they won't be on the ballot in November. Now primary season is almost over, but Country First is just getting warmed up! We're taking the lessons we've learned from our bold [Primary First](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=michigan_recap_nd&n=2) strategy, and keeping the fight going into November. We'll be laying out our general election strategy soon (stay tuned!), but I'll just make one thing clear: Democracy _must_ prevail. Financial and moral support is what's made this possible, so I just want to say "Thank you!" We literally could not be making the impact we are in places like Michigan, and throughout the country, without invested members. So if you're able to [chip in](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=michigan_recap_nd&n=3), or perhaps even make a [recurring donation](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=michigan_recap_nd&n=4) to our movement - awesome! And if now isn't a good time, that's cool, too. Regardless, we're grateful to have you with us! clean_body: | Friend -- 1,327,847. That's the number of voters Country First reached in Michigan during our "Month of Action" ahead of the August 2nd primary election. In state House and Senate districts where a Republican is all but guaranteed to win in November, we focused our efforts on turning out Democrats, Independents, and disaffected Republicans to vote in the GOP primary to defeat Ultra MAGA candidates (many of whom were endorsed by Trump) who otherwise would have won. And we were victorious in 9 out of 10 races! Now you may be wondering, what does a congressman from Illinois care about Michigan? And the answer is simple: Michigan had become ground zero for Ultra MAGA's war on democracy, with a startling number of candidates who participated in January 6th. Their plan was to take over the state legislature and ensure Michigan's 2024 electoral college votes went to their preferred candidate. And while those candidates and their supporters haven't gone anywhere, we know one thing: Democracy is a little safer now that they won't be on the ballot in November. Now primary season is almost over, but Country First is just getting warmed up! We're taking the lessons we've learned from our bold strategy, and keeping the fight going into November. We'll be laying out our general election strategy soon (stay tuned!), but I'll just make one thing clear: Democracy must prevail. Financial and moral support is what's made this possible, so I just want to say "Thank you!" We literally could not be making the impact we are in places like Michigan, and throughout the country, without invested members. So if you're able to , or perhaps even make a to our movement - awesome! And if now isn't a good time, that's cool, too. Regardless, we're grateful to have you with us! | | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the **Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum** -and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum? ** The**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College-and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the **Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum** is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the **Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum** available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $400,000 to promote the**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum** and our other outreach efforts-including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative. _ That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you-citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 177-year-old mission-to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the **Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum** -and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty?**_ Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty-and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty-I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://trk.readactnews._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0xNzc2X2N1cnJpY3VsdW0mdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QUVfUkFOTzA4MDUyMDIyJnNjPU1LMTAyMUVNMiJ9/w7RXt0NA5k7RFphYYPRkYA)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

> _We thought you might want to see this special message from our friends at Republican Accountability PAC._
Friend,

For Trump-endorsed candidates spreading baseless conspiracy theories about the 2020 election being stolen, this week’s primary elections were great. But for anyone who’s worried about believers in the Big Lie having control over elections, it was a very bad week. In the Republican primary for governor in Arizona, Kari Lake was just declared the winner. If you don’t know much about Lake, she’s made election conspiracy theories the center of her campaign and even said she would not have certified the 2020 election results if she were governor at the time. Arizona’s Republican nominee for secretary of state, Mark Finchem, says the same and even attended the January 6 insurrection. U.S. Senate candidate Blake Masters also won his primary. Masters’ highlights—or lowlights—are that he has called World War II an “unjust” war, praised the manifesto of the Unabomber, and of course also spreads the lie that the 2020 election was stolen. In Michigan, Trump-endorsed governor candidate Tudor Dixon is trying to hide her extreme views as she gets ready for the general election, but she also has a long history of claiming the 2020 election was stolen. If elected, she’d be in charge of certifying future Michigan elections. None of these candidates can win in November if we want to protect our democracy. And that’s why you’ll soon hear how RAPAC will elevate the voices of local Republicans to help defeat these Trump loyalists in November. Stay tuned. Sarah Longwell Treasurer, Republican Accountability PAC

Friend, For Trump-endorsed candidates spreading baseless conspiracy theories about the 2020 election being stolen, this week’s primary elections were great. But for anyone who’s worried about believers in the Big Lie having control over elections, it was a very bad week. In the Republican primary for governor in Arizona, Kari Lake was just declared the winner. If you don’t know much about Lake, she’s made election conspiracy theories the center of her campaign and even said she would not have certified the 2020 election results if she were governor at the time. Arizona’s Republican nominee for secretary of state, Mark Finchem, says the same and even attended the January 6 insurrection. U.S. Senate candidate Blake Masters also won his primary. Masters’ highlights—or lowlights—are that he has called World War II an “unjust” war, praised the manifesto of the Unabomber, and of course also spreads the lie that the 2020 election was stolen. In Michigan, Trump-endorsed governor candidate Tudor Dixon is trying to hide her extreme views as she gets ready for the general election, but she also has a long history of claiming the 2020 election was stolen. If elected, she’d be in charge of certifying future Michigan elections. None of these candidates can win in November if we want to protect our democracy. Leaders like Stacey Abrams — who continues to be a leader in the fight for reproductive freedom. = | = Stacey Abrams will be a Governor who stands up for reproductive freedom. And in a moment like this, the stakes couldn’t be higher; it’s up to us to do what we can to ensure she is elected. We cannot afford a Georgia where it’s impossible for people to get the health care they need. Fair Fight empowers voters to make their voices heard at the ballot box. And as we look towards the midterms, it’s never been more important to elect a reproductive rights and voting rights champion like Stacey Abrams. Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s just 12 hours until our next critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $25,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**

If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. Most medical students today are instructed in healthcare policy that promotes government mandates and social justice rather than the latest medical science.

_You and I MUST show these students an alternative_.

Our goal is to educate medical students about positive, proven healthcare policies that preserve and protect the Doctor-Patient relationship.

| _**Regan Deering for Congress **_
---
| | | Dear Peter,

I don’t believe you can spend inflation away. But the far-Left seems to think they can . . .

The brand new "Inflation Reduction Act" is actually a $433 billion Schumer-Manchin tax-and-spend package!

This reckless package will be paid for by increasing taxes on hard-working Americans who are already struggling with skyrocketing energy prices and the highest inflation in four decades.

Yet, Joe Biden [pledged ](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=c0f84cd966&e=2fa613cb76)not to raise taxes for Americans making less than $400,000 a year and yet, by 2023 this legislation is [expected to](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=2fd1039633&e=2fa613cb76) increase taxes by $16.7 billion on American taxpayers earning less than $200,000 and by $14.1 billion from taxpayers earning between $200,000 and $500,000.

We need to deal with inflation head-on by reducing regulations on our businesses and encouraging them to invest, innovate, produce and manufacture here in the United States. We need some more adults in the room who are willing to provide immediate relief, along with long-term solutions based on economic principles, rather than quick-fix spending sprees.

Not more rubber stamps for the Biden-Pelosi-Schumer agenda, an agenda my opponent, Nikki Budzinski, is quite familiar with as a Biden Administration alum.

If you want CHANGE in Washington, vote for me.

#
**My Fellow Patriot,**

Did you know that while Americans are suffering from the BORDER INVASION and the RECORD-BREAKING GAS PRICES and the BABY FORMULA SHORTAGES, and the 100 other ways Joe Biden has devastated this country, Nancy Pelosi and RINO Liz Cheney are squarely focused on presenting a NATIONAL TV SHOW TRIAL for something that happened 18 months ago — **AND HAS HAD ZERO NEGATIVE IMPACT ON OUR COUNTRY!**

The Democrats are going to try to ACTIVATE THEIR BASE by using the January 6th Capitol Protest to paint the Republican party as _“insurrectionists and traitors_.”

**This is all they have left, since abortion and gun control aren’t working.**

The Jan 6 farce is utter nonsense, completely false, and a colossal waste of time and money — but for me as a Republican it will be painful because it shows once again that Democrats are not trying to UNITE with us, they're trying to EXTERMINATE US!
[HELP LEON STAND UP FOR AMERICA!](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=4d0167132d&e=3cd8121505) **My name is Leon Benjamin and the one thing Democrats ARE getting right is that our _democracy IS on the precipice of extinction._**__

But it’s not because of anything the Republicans are doing; it’s because of EVERYTHING the Democrats are doing!

For 18 months the Democrats have skirted or circumvented every check and balance put in place to keep us a constitutional republic, and this January 6 HOAX is the cherry on top of a pile of crap! This type of state-sponsored propaganda was laughed at when Russia did it back in the 70s, so why would we accept it TODAY, here in the land of freedom?

**BECAUSE BIDEN VOTE****RS REMAIN CLUELESS THAT THEY’VE BEEN PLAYED BY THEIR PARTY AND BY THEIR MEDIA.**

The good news is that Biden has screwed things up so royally for EVERY AMERICAN ON BOTH SIDES OF THE AISLE, that none of what the Dems are trying is really sticking.

The bad news is that they won't stop until the existing Republican party has been folded into their globalist empire of fascism.

**I’m running for office to stop that.**

Liz Cheney and RINOs like her need to be rooted out of our esteemed party, and the only way to do that is by VOTING THEM OUT. We just had another massively successful round of primaries, but we all know from 2020 that Democrats don't believe in fair elections anymore.

So we have to stop them with UNBEATABLE NUMBERS. **God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=e7c8d0f248&e=3cd8121505)

What does letting Medicare negotiate drug prices mean for Americans?
#
Peter,
What does letting Medicare negotiate drug prices mean for Americans? Lower prescription costs, healthier families, and more money in your pockets.
The Inflation Reduction Act would give us historic power to lower drug costs through Medicare negotiations. But instead of fighting to put families first, Mitch McConnell is busy calling it “socialistic” instead.
Right now, people don’t pick up life saving medication because they can’t afford it. There are steps we can take to make these drugs more affordable, but Republicans are standing in the way.
We need to pass the Inflation Reduction Act and let Medicare negotiate drug prices to invest in our futures and invest in our families.

name: American Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0580%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=SAdq0pHoCP1FxqNhr80DWQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30587%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XXgGeS9u1wkEwvSfmCtemQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30588%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Q3KzBwBFUpTq7zFfjQUlqw&sysid=1) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30589%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kdCuxHyiYbt%2bTuq%2fsLb1BQ&sysid=1)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

body:
I need your help to flip Republican Del. Brenda Thiam's seat in Hagerstown. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6a9ac1f6ec5c/lets-flip-a-state-delegate-seat?e=db24e76724)
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Friends, Neighbors, and Statewide Advocates:
My name is Brooke Grossman, and I'm the Democratic Nominee for MD House of Delegates District 2B (encompassing the Hagerstown city limits). The seat is currently held by Del. Brenda Thiam, a Republican who tows the party line when she's actively "representing" us, which isn't even that often- absenteeism on prevalent issues both statewide and in our local community is a common occurrence.

I'm personally writing this email to ask for your support. Why? Because District 2B is one of, if not the most flippable seat in the House of Delegates. The people here are clearly sick of do-nothing representation that doesn't listen. We just need to get the message out that there is an alternative; a bright vision for the future that allows our community to reach its full potential.

What does that support look like? Of course, I would be forever grateful if you could spare a donation, even of $10 or $20, at the following link: [https://donorbox.org/grossman-for-hagerstown](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=d09f9ab78a&e=db24e76724). Your money will be put to good use- we intend to use every dollar for our operations, from door hangers to mailers to strategic signage to volunteer supplies to phonebanking.

If you happen to have any connections that may be useful to our campaign, if you are able to spare some time on the ground to volunteer, or if you would like to set up a meeting with me and my campaign, please email me at [brooke@grossmanforhagerstown.com](mailto:brooke@grossmanforhagerstown.com).

To learn more about our campaign and what I stand for, check out our website at [grossmanforhagerstown.com](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=c30570a753&e=db24e76724).

I promise you, Western Maryland has a lot of exciting developments and potential, both economically and socially. Electing an active, knowledgeable Delegate with deep roots in the community and an even deeper understanding of what it means to be a public servant as Hagerstown's representative will help our region flourish. Your help in flipping this seat will not only benefit our city but the state as a whole. I will proudly serve Marylanders alongside Wes Moore as his administration enacts a vision that leaves no one behind.

Thank you for your consideration,

Brooke Grossman

[View this message in your browser](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2ztqje0c3o047j0vdv8gq06oqebqc4s5mrkdtjr0g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkeq32t5nmeq33cjl61qn4cdkmoq37c3nm6or9ctn6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcd9me2q78chmepgm9djj6ar62dj6cmr78oj0m4obephkmhgj2tbl6hr70o34c3jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcsbgmdg6fcjhcpqe1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdim9pr2c1hm9oj24no)
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zu3n4orbhehqnce19b2q24o0qukri8652c8f2v60_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sth60or4s9h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z41f5r01c759v89r934cdv2b9m913p4uaej73c70_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sth60or4s9h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zfe3r1d93eenah5kev21k2b0d1qbkvfj57hqejl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sth60or4s9h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zn92a68f22vpkp6kjcjl91o5bm0pdrggbnamehe8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sth60or4s9h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zjvnkb8a1f222ji93psarc0n5igfj2ctk644kss8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sth60or4s9h2bs)

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Democrat Nikki Budzinski is running for Congress in Illinois' 13th District. This district is currently in Republican hands, and is by far one of the most competitive in the entire country.

Nikki has spent her life fighting for workers and working families by strengthening unions nationwide, and she was instrumental in passing a $15 minimum wage in Illinois while working as a senior advisor for Governor JB Pritzker. | | Here’s the thing about polls: **_They show a possible future._**

Some polls show Rev. Warnock winning over his Trump-backed opponent.

Some polls show Stacey Abrams in a virtual TIE with Brian Kemp, gaining momentum to take the lead.

It’s been a long, long road to get here. But the U.S. Senate is finally on the verge of passing a powerfully important bill, the Inflation Reduction Act, to bring down costs for families and tackle climate change head on. Is it everything we need? No, so I’m going to keep fighting to get things like universal child care, paid family leave, and increasing the child tax credit in the next big bill like this. And I’m going to keep fighting to elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House so we can get even more done. But this is what we can accomplish right now — and we must. Our planet is on fire. Families are forced to choose between filling prescriptions or buying groceries. Billionaire CEOs are laughing all the way to the bank as their corporations aren’t pitching in to keep our country running. It’s long past time to fight back. [_**The Senate could vote on this bill in the coming days. If you agree that Congress must act to fight climate change, tackle inflation, bring down the cost of prescription drugs, and crack down on freeloading corporations and wealthy tax cheats, add your name to support the Inflation Reduction Act today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48829024/359760269/505696056?refcode=EMZ7B_INF_E_20220805_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWJmMmQxNi1lNzE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6Vlfa-c8A9ZJwnU6wy5IyLVCA394y-Wdj564zFtHZlM=&emci=6ebf2d16-e714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=71bf2d16-e714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) Here are some of the big pieces:
* Reducing carbon emissions in the United States by 40% in eight years with the biggest-ever federal investment in fighting climate change.
* For the first time in history, allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prescription drug prices.
* Making sure giant corporations with over $1 billion in profits pay a 15% minimum tax on those profits, and targeting increased IRS enforcement to crack down on wealthy tax cheats.

These are game-changers for families, for our economy, and for the future of our planet. **But let’s be clear: the entire Republican Party is lined up against this plan.** They’re not in the business of solving the climate crisis or helping families make ends meet. They think Fortune 500 corporations should be free to exploit loophole after loophole to bring their tax bills down to zero. They don’t want the IRS to have more resources to go after wealthy tax cheats. They’re going to try to add poison pill amendments to bring the whole bill down. **And corporate lobbyists are scrambling to stop this deal from becoming law.** We’ve got to show that Washington works for working families, not powerful interests — but we’ve got the slimmest possible Senate majority, and it’s going to take a fight to get this over the finish line. We are only 4 days away.

| Hello Peter,

Most of my time in recent days has been spent on the campaign trail, knocking on doors and making my case to voters face to face. We’ve been _everywhere_ around our district, from Chippewa Falls to Platteville. In fact, I’m out walking around Stevens Point right now!

Connecting with the hardworking people of this district is one of the most rewarding parts of campaigning.

I wanted to take a moment while we’re between conversations, though, to let you know just how deeply I’ve appreciated your support over the past many, many months. **Having such steadfast encouragement from grassroots supporters like you has made the hard days a little bit easier.**

I know we have asked over and over for you to donate to power our campaign, but with only four days remaining until this competitive primary is over, we’ll need to keep asking. After all, we have to be prepared to take on Derrick Van Orden and the GOP in November!

So please, while I have you here, could you contribute $25 towards our pre-primary fundraising goal? We had to raise our target to meet increased expenses, so I would really appreciate your help.
