name: Carl Marlinga
subject: An open letter on Michigan's abortion ban
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MARLINGA FOR CONGRESS
body:
Peter,

As a former elected county prosecuting attorney, I respectfully urge the
prosecuting attorneys of this state to not enforce Michigan’s 1931 statute
criminalizing abortion.

A preeminent power invested in the office of prosecuting attorney is the
discretion to determine whether and to what extent the laws of this state
should be enforced. The prosecutor is expected to act as the “conscience of the
community.” In the case of the 1931 felony stature criminalizing abortions,
with no exceptions other than to save the life of the mother, there is wisdom
and compassion in not enforcing that law.

The people of the State of Michigan will decide on November 8, 2022, whether
the protections of Roe v Wade will be adopted as part of the Michigan
Constitution. If that measure passes, the prosecution of physicians and women
in the next three months will serve no purpose other than public humiliation.
The convictions, if any were to be obtained, would have to be reversed. Common
sense dictates that there be a moratorium on prosecutions until the people have
spoken.

Beyond that consideration, the 1931 law is fundamentally flawed. The law makes
no exception for victims of rape or incest. Surely nobody would require a
12-year-old child victim of rape or incest to carry a pregnancy to term. If
permitting an abortion for a victim of that age would be the right thing to do,
why would it not also be the right thing to do for a 13-year-old, or a
14-year-old, or an 18-year-old, or a victim of any age?

Even the exception for the life of the mother is problematic. What does that
exception mean? If a woman is told that she has a thirty percent chance of
dying if she continues her pregnancy, does that make her eligible for a
life-saving abortion? What percentage risk of death is sufficient to qualify?
It goes without saying that prosecutors are woefully ill equipped to make the
call. Yet under the 1931 law, the determination as to whether a life is
sufficiently in peril will have to be made by the mother, her physician, and
her county prosecutor. This invasion into a private medical consultation is
totally unacceptable. The discrimination based on sex is also palpable. Imagine
if a man were told that he had a medical condition that might result in his
death but was then told that he could not receive treatment because the
likelihood of death was not high enough.

The law intrudes on the privacy rights of every expectant mother. To cite one
horrifying example, if a woman suffers the heartbreak of a miscarriage, she
will inevitably become the target of a of criminal investigation. Her medical
records will be reviewed, as the investigation tries to sort out whether the
miscarriage occurred naturally or whether it was induced. No person should have
to face the threat of criminal prosecution after having suffered such a loss.

The danger of unequal enforcement and the absence of clear standards are at
the core of what it means to deny equal protection and due process of law under
the Michigan Constitution. Prosecutors are constitutionally and legally free to
apply their understanding of what these terms mean – even without waiting for a
court decision. Indeed, they are required to do so.

I applaud those prosecutors who have already announced their intentions to not
prosecute. I urge all others to adopt the same view. Let women have the freedom
to make their own decisions on their health care, and let doctors be allowed to
practice medicine without threat of criminal penalties

Carl J. Marlinga

PAID FOR BY MARLINGA FOR CONGRESS

155 S. Main #46232
Mt. Clemens, MI 48046

The law intrudes on the privacy rights of every expectant mother. To cite one horrifying example, if a woman suffers the heartbreak of a miscarriage, she will inevitably become the target of a of criminal investigation. Her medical records will be reviewed, as the investigation tries to sort out whether the miscarriage occurred naturally or whether it was induced. No person should have to face the threat of criminal prosecution after having suffered such a loss. The danger of unequal enforcement and the absence of clear standards are at the core of what it means to deny equal protection and due process of law under the Michigan Constitution. Prosecutors are constitutionally and legally free to apply their understanding of what these terms mean – even without waiting for a court decision. Indeed, they are required to do so. I applaud those prosecutors who have already announced their intentions to not prosecute. I urge all others to adopt the same view. Let women have the freedom to make their own decisions on their health care, and let doctors be allowed to practice medicine without threat of criminal penalties Carl J. Marlinga PAID FOR BY MARLINGA FOR CONGRESS Marlinga for Congress 155 S. Main #46232 Mt. Clemens, MI 48046

If there’s any hope of expanding our majority, we need to capitalize on our momentum.
#

National Journal’s Hotline just updated their “Senate Power Rankings,” and they have North Carolina as one of the top three seats “most likely to flip” blue!
If there’s any hope of expanding our majority, we need to capitalize on our momentum. [**Please make a donation right now to send Cheri Beasley to the U.S. Senate.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220805-1-ma&t=1&akid=1392%2E357359%2Eu_w1R7)

Republican super PACs have limitless sums of corporate dark money and are willing to spend whatever it takes to defeat us. They are dead set on buying this seat for Ted Budd because, if we beat them, Democrats are almost guaranteed to hold the Senate majority.

body:
We must come together and demand that Congress act with urgency to address the climate crisis

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=760%2E61531%2EBvWXEq)
Hello,
We recently had our first heat wave of the season in Vermont—six consecutive days of the temperature being 90 degrees or higher. And because of climate change, these heat waves are growing more common and more extreme.
**In fact, the average number of heat wave days in Vermont is projected to increase from 10 a year currently, to nearly 50 days a year by 2050.** Not only is this rise in temperatures damaging for the environment, but it also affects our livelihoods and quality of life.
This is why I’ve been fighting for a Green New Deal. Because climate change is the existential threat of our time. **We must come together and demand that Congress act with urgency to address this, and that’s what I’ll do on my first day in the Senate.[ If you can, will you chip in $5 or more to help build a movement for a Green New Deal?](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3725?t=3&akid=760%2E61531%2EBvWXEq)**
[CHIP IN ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3725?t=7&t=8&akid=760%2E61531%2EBvWXEq)
---
Rising temperatures affect all of us. But for Vermont’s most vulnerable communities—people experiencing homelessness, the elderly, the chronically ill, those who lack transportation and air conditioning—the sweltering heat can be life or death. That gets even more concerning when you consider that Burlington is ranked among the top “heat islands” in the country.
**_E_ _very_ American—no matter who they voted for, no matter their ZIP code—deserves to live on a sustainable planet. **
A Green New Deal would provide the opportunity to invest in sustainable housing infrastructure and create good jobs that fight climate change. We can establish a national renewable energy standard, accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles, and more. But we need Congress to acknowledge the urgency of this moment, and Republicans in Washington to stop burying their heads in the sand.
I’m proud to be an original cosponsor of the Green New Deal—I hope you’ll chip in [**whatever you can to send me to the Senate to go get the job done.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3725?t=4&akid=760%2E61531%2EBvWXEq)
Thanks so much,

Peter

| | | [](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=8aee8d3111314a989881d632f374bf0b&_e=Q_EFQTrQTKYjMnQ2hX3GaeCp2jKtFzjMN4Bkb3NL3_nAUR0MsLLeEIHAwvSzoWpncYGCb7f4QEDLup3wGdJTmIQMeYOfbkoa6x9u6B2avFZi1KSOTx9zfOQa5weGnL-heb2nSVtl_eMebrRpDvjU8dbbfoBKk3Ti95WtNNVOa0sUMDnepWK4cPO9tkkBxDqtK1f5w-YGpcMEJ1_cbtUymHjNZoh7tfGDZq8vfEDM7XNb9T6SRwi8yt2jTFLRnFb52vD_1ymhHmlLfdbWHdBdRzvt9IIunXzI41Hd86jL4lIsHnVvsfDmK3xUlW4LDdfGePfrpMCWtrm04yVf8N7nsDXs4B1pKBc49U_v0lfkEtb_vQgmc892CBGDvN7vmSauILE6G5Nj-svnNUHqSDZB0dW75jywmuVPATLqMM_ch6dUHN7yu5X6zZsV7BQ19A3z)

Friend,
---
Running for office was one of the scariest things I ever did. I had no experience. Nobody thought I could win. Some people thought I should just stay home with my young children. I didn’t listen. Why? Well, that story goes back a while. ** ** I started doing the books at my mom's store when I was just 13. After graduating with an accounting degree and working in the corporate world, I came back to the family store. Even at a young age, I saw how hard it is to make a dollar and how easy it is for the government to take it away. The government had its hand in everything. They charged sales tax to our customers, property tax on our building, taxes on the equipment in our building, and then income tax on whatever we took in. I started talking to other small business owners and listened to their stories. Turns out, I wasn’t alone! ** ** When I mentioned my frustrations to my mom, she said one of her favorite things: “Don’t complain. Do something about it.” ** ** So I did. ** ** I decided the best way to take a stand was to run for the state legislature. South Carolina had plenty of lawyers and career politicians in the legislature; it needed an accountant who understood the struggles small business owners face. ** ** It wasn’t easy. I was running against a 30-year incumbent that resorted to every trick in the book. My opponent sent out a mailer filled with sexist and racist lies. But if he thought _that_ was going to stop me, he clearly didn’t know that his vicious attacks only fueled my competitive spirit. I took my message to the people of South Carolina and told them if they gave me a chance to fight for them, I would spend every moment in office proving that they made the right decision. ** ****I think about those years in the trenches now as I travel across the country campaigning for new candidates — principled conservatives who want to make a difference at every level of government.** ** ** **My experience as a candidate taught me how important it is to get good, honest people running for office.** But, sadly, that’s not always enough. Winning takes resources and time. Sometimes, you’re an underdog running against a 30-year incumbent. Sometimes, you’re spending countless hours fending off ridiculous attacks.** ** That’s why I’m doing what I’m doing. That’s why I launched Stand For America PAC more than a year and a half ago. And that’s why I’m criss-crossing the nation working to get strong conservatives elected to office. ** ** When I ran that first time, I was lucky to have good people by my side who worked tirelessly with me. Today, I’m just as fortunate. I know we can win this November because **[I have people like you who are stepping up one person at a time with a donation to fund our efforts.](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=8aee8d3111314a989881d632f374bf0b&_e=Q_EFQTrQTKYjMnQ2hX3GaeCp2jKtFzjMN4Bkb3NL3_nAUR0MsLLeEIHAwvSzoWpncYGCb7f4QEDLup3wGdJTmIQMeYOfbkoa6x9u6B2avFZi1KSOTx9zfOQa5weGnL-heb2nSVtl_eMebrRpDvjU8dbbfoBKk3Ti95WtNNVOa0sUMDnepWK4cPO9tkkBxDqtK1f5w-YGpcMEJ1_cbtUymG_eln6UZPWH3_9U1DyBfmX31HO1DbtneTjeiVIZjBfnk3UBYQlZYnnQZCfGqHOu5MIhOzEohZNUfFLPag8r5cK-k7BU70_jmSYgR3fIfKn0_YrIBdWazxfJkeH5ss2kFYDAhPh9FbybminCBpphaXwn4stUYD2buNcFxH3TKkJnBAtcIfKjt55fdORu_ihak_3qjdPWrjP9vDLV_rfTHj5kw5EwdcFvcf1uymtBs0fK) **** ** It’s why I’m so appreciative of whatever you can do to help — even if you have $1 to spare to help fund these important efforts. [**If you can donate today, I’m hoping you will.**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=8aee8d3111314a989881d632f374bf0b&_e=Q_EFQTrQTKYjMnQ2hX3GaeCp2jKtFzjMN4Bkb3NL3_nAUR0MsLLeEIHAwvSzoWpncYGCb7f4QEDLup3wGdJTmIQMeYOfbkoa6x9u6B2avFZi1KSOTx9zfOQa5weGnL-heb2nSVtl_eMebrRpDvjU8dbbfoBKk3Ti95WtNNVOa0sUMDnepWK4cPO9tkkBxDqtK1f5w-YGpcMEJ1_cbtUymPP8qKm3qkL6Lql76RL0iMD_UPsv0zWBZGze7wlezohnnrk7EJ_bEVfZRDbLQsRJp2wJw52_mKskgoYOlAVBp2mk_SLSjUJK58RI4vyhEADsPW5lgiRGVtwiYzfAwNNdpgFr7X_jVea8rAWlF-H-KmYDcB1_sP0JdqkkU5hwk0JkCIWbogO1TZbIkF6Af4N4KcecoQeWwJtcN8OYxKMM8weJsmDTYCsPqvfKesmWArPm)** ** Thank you in advance for all of your support. clean_body: | | | Friend, Running for office was one of the scariest things I ever did. I had no experience. Nobody thought I could win. Some people thought I should just stay home with my young children. I didn’t listen. Why? Well, that story goes back a while. I started doing the books at my mom's store when I was just 13. After graduating with an accounting degree and working in the corporate world, I came back to the family store. Even at a young age, I saw how hard it is to make a dollar and how easy it is for the government to take it away. The government had its hand in everything. They charged sales tax to our customers, property tax on our building, taxes on the equipment in our building, and then income tax on whatever we took in. I started talking to other small business owners and listened to their stories. Turns out, I wasn’t alone! When I mentioned my frustrations to my mom, she said one of her favorite things: “Don’t complain. Do something about it.” So I did. I decided the best way to take a stand was to run for the state legislature. South Carolina had plenty of lawyers and career politicians in the legislature; it needed an accountant who understood the struggles small business owners face. It wasn’t easy. I was running against a 30-year incumbent that resorted to every trick in the book. My opponent sent out a mailer filled with sexist and racist lies. But if he thought that was going to stop me, he clearly didn’t know that his vicious attacks only fueled my competitive spirit. I took my message to the people of South Carolina and told them if they gave me a chance to fight for them, I would spend every moment in office proving that they made the right decision. I think about those years in the trenches now as I travel across the country campaigning for new candidates — principled conservatives who want to make a difference at every level of government. My experience as a candidate taught me how important it is to get good, honest people running for office. But, sadly, that’s not always enough. Winning takes resources and time. Sometimes, you’re an underdog running against a 30-year incumbent. Sometimes, you’re spending countless hours fending off ridiculous attacks. That’s why I’m doing what I’m doing. That’s why I launched Stand For America PAC more than a year and a half ago. And that’s why I’m criss-crossing the nation working to get strong conservatives elected to office. When I ran that first time, I was lucky to have good people by my side who worked tirelessly with me. Today, I’m just as fortunate. I know we can win this November because It’s why I’m so appreciative of whatever you can do to help — even if you have $1 to spare to help fund these important efforts. Thank you in advance for all of your support. Together, we can elect a wave of conservatives in the fall and put our country back on track. My very best, Nikki Haley | DON’T MISS THIS UPDATE Did you know Nikki Haley recently endorsed a new slate of candidates for the upcoming midterm elections? body:
Dear Friend,

Have you signed up yet for the virtual event on Aug. 11, Participate PA: How the War on Labor Became the Holy War ?

Rachel Tabachnick, independent researcher and former fellow with social justice think tank Political Research Associates, will discuss this pressing topic.

She’s explored her widely-cited research on NPR’s Fresh Air and presented at the first PA Progressive Summit on “biblical capitalism” and the economic and anti-labor agenda of religious right leadership and funders. Now, more than a decade later, she’ll present an update of that session.

Participate PA: How the War on Labor Became the Holy War
[https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/laborwar]
Thursday, August 11, 2022
5:30 - 8:00 p.m.

We’ll explore:

- How and why the U.S. religious right is a major player in anti-labor policy and propaganda and the promotion of “right to work” legislation, and

- How we challenge this when it is packaged as religious belief.

Sign up today!
[https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/laborwar]

And please remember to stay on top of our upcoming events here: https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events [https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events]

See you there!

L aura Nevitt

Brenda is going to become the Democratic Nominee for Governor on Tuesday. body:
| It's official: I am the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Missouri, and I'll be facing off against Eric Schmitt.

The stakes have never been higher. **If you send me to the Senate, I will be the 51st vote we need to pass truly comprehensive gun reform, protect the right to an abortion, and break through the partisan divide.**

And I know we can win. Our momentum is building like never before, but our opponent, Eric Schmitt, will be mobilizing powerful forces to defeat us. **I need you with me in this fight.** [Please, can you split a donation between me and Voter Protection Project to power this campaign all the way to November?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20901?t=6&akid=3980%2E878179%2EVmobnh)

Folks know that it's time for something different. And they know I'll lead with compassion and prioritize people, not partisanship. As a nurse, I'll listen to you and your concerns, not to the lobbyists. **A nurse has never been elected to the Senate, but Washington sure could use the honesty, integrity, and problem-solving skills that nurses like me exemplify.**

We're taking this campaign all the way to Washington – and we've got a long road ahead of us. Our opponent has deep-pocketed allies who will do anything to keep this Senate seat red.

**But we have something even more powerful:_you._** By donating even just $1, you're powering our campaign forward and making an investment to end the opioid crisis, make daily life more affordable, and bring kindness and compassion to Washington.

**We have a big fight ahead of us, and I can't take on Eric Schmitt without you on my team. So far in 2022, nearly 12,000 Americans have lost their lives due to an act of gun violence. We can and must do more to keep our communities safe. Last week, the House passed a bill introduced by Congressman David Cicilline that would ban assault weapons. This is a step in the right direction to getting deadly weapons off the streets and protecting Americans from gun violence. But Seth knows there is more work to be done, and in Congress, he'll support common sense gun safety legislation to keep Rhode Islanders safe. As Rhode Island Treasurer, Seth divested the state’s pension fund from companies that manufacture assault weapons for non-military use. Seth has also been working to restrict sales and purchases of firearm kits, components, and accessories used to assemble undetectable "ghost guns." In Congress, Seth will support common sense gun safety legislation – including background checks, red flag laws, and a federal assault weapons ban. In contrast, his Republican opponent, Allan Fung, doesn't support any kind of limitations on assault weapons and opposed Rhode Island's red flag law, which protects victims of domestic violence by giving law enforcement the ability to confiscate firearms from those who are an immediate danger to themselves or others. Fung received an A rating from the NRA which also donated to his campaign. Thank you, Team Seth Rhode Island Treasurer Seth Magaziner is running for Congress in Rhode Island's competitive open Second District – and election experts are calling this race a "toss up." Fellow American,

If you've read recent emails from my campaign, you'll recall that a far-Left columnist - and a regular guest on MSNBC - has trained his fire on me. Since April, he has lobbed multiple racial epithets against me that are offensive to me personally and to the entire Black community.

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_

_**"I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (I.E. HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_

This is a longer email, Peter, but it’s one of the most important ones we’ve sent this year. First, a major update: Sen. Sinema reached a deal with Majority Leader Chuck Schumer last night to secure her vote for the reconciliation bill. It’s fantastic news that the legislation is now moving forward.**** But here’s the upshot: **Sinema prioritized a tax break for hedge funds before she would agree to protect health care, lower drug prices, and make climate investments.** Sinema refused to add her support until Democrats agreed to drop the “carried interest” provision which would have tightened a tax loophole for some of the wealthiest Americans, including hedge fund managers and private equity execs. Here’s a quick reminder from Huffpost about why Sinema took this position:
> _Her business-friendly positioning has paid dividends for her campaign account: In 2021 alone, she received more than_** _$144,000_** _in donations from industry groups that lobbied against closing the carried interest loophole. More recently, she took in_** _$100,000_** _from Wall Street and_** _$50,000_** _from pharmaceutical companies in the second quarter of 2022 alone._

When their greed conflicts with the urgent needs of Arizonans, she will put her rich donors first. Every. Single. Time. We’re thrilled that Democrats’ major legislation to invest in health care and climate is moving forward — even though, thanks to Sinema and Manchin it’s been drastically scaled back from the original proposals. Sinema is in the U.S. Senate for her special interests. When their greed conflicts with the urgent needs of Arizonans, she will put her rich donors first. Every. Single. Time. We’re thrilled that Democrats’ major legislation to invest in health care and climate is moving forward — even though, thanks to Sinema and Manchin it’s been drastically scaled back from the original proposals. But we’re more clear than ever that if we want to continue making progress — eliminating the filibuster, passing voting rights, codifying Roe, and pursuing a working families first agenda — our mission remains unchanged: We MUST replace Sinema with a REAL Democrat. There’s one more thing to consider here, Peter. Our job just got more difficult. Thanks to Sinema’s “service” saving Wall Street’s beloved carried interest loophole, you can bet there’s a ton of wealthy donors ready to support Sinema’s re-election. Do you know what a candidate statement is? | | | Do you know what a candidate statement is? Candidate statements, featured in voter guides, are an opportunity for candidates to tell **every registered voter** who they are, and why they are running. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

name: Great America Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6226%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=Hr5xjcjJJrmKLAImlcAqlw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64262%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9tdmJTFUSYi8pHh1pVp2zQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64263%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zbqdoa6lpzXKsd38rH2pGw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64263%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zbqdoa6lpzXKsd38rH2pGw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
_107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314_

| Hi —

I want to reach you before the weekend personally after Tuesday’s primary.

Elections are a choice—and there are a lot of differences between me and my new opponent.

**I’m proud to be born and raised in Flint. I raised my family here, and am proud to call mid-Michigan home.** My new opponent grew up in California and spent 43 years of his life outside of Michigan, before recently moving here to run for Congress.

**I’m fighting to lower the cost of gas and take on Big Oil price gouging.** My new opponent owns over $100,000 in ExxonMobil stock, so as Big Oil companies do well, he does well too.

**I support women’s access to reproductive health care.** My new opponent wants a total abortion ban, even in cases of rape and incest.

**Our campaign has the support of thousands of grassroots supporters just like you, giving an average of $22.87.** My new opponent has self-funded his own campaign with $1.25 million to date, and has only had four donations from Michiganders.

Fellow American,

For the first time in Georgia's history, both Democrats and Republicans have nominated a Black man for the U.S. Senate.

This is indeed historic and speaks to the greatness of America's experiment with democracy. Less than 70 years ago, people like Senator Raphael Warnock and me were not able to attend the same schools as white children.

Now, we're running against one another - two Black men - in what is shaping up to be the most competitive Senate race of the entire 2022 midterm elections. Fox News has even gone so far as to say, _**"The U.S. Senate race in Georgia is key for determining control of the upper house next year."**_

**That may be where the similarities end.**

If you've read recent emails from my campaign, you'll recall that a far-Left columnist - and a regular guest on MSNBC - has trained his fire on me. Since April, he has lobbed multiple racial epithets against me that are offensive to me personally and to the entire Black community.

In the past, he said:

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_
---

and
_**"I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (I.E. HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_
---

This week, he went on MSNBC and lobbed his most disgusting attack yet: _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their Negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

**Shame on him for saying it, and shame on MSNBC for airing it.**

Despite these racially based insults making national news, Senator Warnock has said nothing.

I’m terrified and I’m outraged.
| | |
---
Folks –
Roe v. Wade is over – which means that instead of being a constitutional right, access to abortion is on the ballot.
I’m terrified and I’m outraged. We can’t leave the most personal decisions about our bodies up to right-wing extremists like Mitch McConnell – who has threatened to ban abortion nationwide if he returns to the Senate majority leader’s office.
That’s why I’m doing everything in my power to protect the Democratic Senate majority – starting with supporting my friend Maggie Hassan’s campaign. **[I am reaching out to you today to ask you to do the same. Will you please send $3 to Maggie right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48842715/359791318/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1365-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWFlZWQxMi1mZTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SOJmt1vOkvI05dgFyrkshoqt9wIbG90QWcO5YM3207g=)**

| | Open Letter: Dear Former GOP Candidates, Support Tudor, Unity's better than personal ambition. "I fully support Tudor and I encourage all of you, Former Republican Governor Candidates, to stand behind Tudor. Campaign with the same vigor for Tudor as you did for your campaign. It would be a shame and in my opinion, a grave mistake to sit back or worse to attack Tudor including her victory in the just concluded Republican Primaries instead of truly unifying and defeating Whitmer. This is a fight for our people in Michigan and we must keep our eyes on the victory we can all achieve by standing together. I regard you all in very high esteem for standing up for our people in Michigan and so do hundreds of thousands of Michigan Citizens, a point made very clear at the polls recently. I now implore you to show me, nay our people in Michigan, that they mean more to you than any personal ambition. Austin Chenge, US Army Veteran and Former Republican Gov Candidate for Michigan.

Friend,

clean_body: | Friend, Before we get started and I go any further, I’d just like to take a moment to thank you for your time and previous support in advance. It’s what powers our campaign to fight for hardworking Americans across the country. Look, I know it gets old with our campaign texting, emailing, and calling you nonstop, but I’d be lying if I didn’t say that your support is the LIFEBLOOD OF OUR CAMPAIGN. | I hope you know that the main reason I’m running for the U.S. Senate seat in Ohio is because I care deeply about my state, my country, and the issues that we’re facing right now. I grew up in Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once a booming manufacturing town where Ohioans could live a middle-class life. As I got older, I realized that the jobs and economic opportunities that were once present in my hometown were fading away and it left the community around me grasping for hope. Look, I won’t sugarcoat it, my home life wasn’t all peaches and cream. I had my fair share of turbulence at home as a kid, with my dad leaving home when I was young, and my mother struggling with drug addiction her entire life. I’m so lucky that I had someone who helped me turn everything around and keep me straight. That person was my Mamaw (my grandmother). My grandmother taught me tough love, discipline, and that the world wasn’t just going to hand you what you wanted. She kept me straight and focused through her dedication to faith, family, and the hope of a better life that lay ahead (or it could’ve been the 19 handguns she owned.) You wouldn’t believe it from the photo above, but I went on to serve my nation in the Iraq War as a proud Marine, graduated from The Ohio State University, received my law degree from Yale Law School, and wrote a bestselling book. That wasn’t enough. I wanted to do more. I wanted to do more for my state and my country. That’s why when I moved back to Ohio and saw the state I love devastated by job loss, addiction, economic turmoil, and much more, I started a business in Cincinnati focused on growing companies that create well-paying jobs. I’m not done yet though, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because Ohio and America need a true conservative who’s focused on standing up to Communist China, securing our Southern Border, and looking out for the people who’ve been left behind. Because I know what that feels like. So, if you’re committed to putting America First again, if you’re committed to standing up to the Woke Left’s Socialist Agenda, and you’re focused on protecting your freedoms and conservative values, Let’s ride. It’s time to get back to work. God Bless you and your family, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. ##
5 August 22

**Thank You for your support!**

There are 7 weeks until mail-in ballots are sent out (Sep 24) and 11 weeks until early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference. Please seize THIS moment!

Phase II, leading to the General election, has several components:
1) Local media and social media presence
2) Volunteer recruitment
3) Fundraising
4) Signage throughout the District
5) Pre-recorded voicemail team
6) Texting voters
7) Sign Waving
8) Prayer

Here are some questions to consider:
Who do you know that has Press contacts, Press experience or social media experience?
Who can help with sign installation?
How many hours per week can you give to leave Jeff Warner's pre-recorded message with voters?
Who can you help enlist to be part of this amazing team?
Can you give at least one hour per week to campaign for the residents of MD4?

Jeff has continued to interact with voters while sign waving at major intersections throughout the District. The response in these strong democratic areas is very positive. It appears that the worse the economy becomes, the more powerful Jeff Warner's message of hope and restoration resonates with voters. Something special is happening!

**Sign Waving**
This Saturday, August 6
Noon-1p
The intersection of Pennsylvania Ave (Rt 4) & Forestville Rd.
Park in the Industrial Bank Parking Lot
7610 Pennsylvania Ave., Forestville, 20747
FREE JW4C Tshirt provided for those who have not yet received one.

We are asking you for your donations and we are asking for your service. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 13 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=f148220605&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

Good news, : not only is voting by mail is secure, legal, popular— it's here to stay. In a 5-2 decision released Tuesday, Pennsylvania Supreme Court Justices rejected the GOP argument that the legislature did not have the power under the state constitution to allow Pennsylvanians to vote by mail without an excuse.
This decision by the Pennsylvania Supreme Court is a major win for Pennsylvania’s electorate. Confirming that making the ballot more accessible by expanding the ways in which every day citizens can vote is worthy of celebration. Our independent judiciary matters and the PA Supreme Court should be thanked for ruling in favor of We the People. #CourtsMatter

Hello,
Well, it didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
**In order to fight back, we need to raise another $25,000 before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but the only way we’ll hit our goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now:**

subject: Why I created the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC1t-U04W-0sQB3aZlwy_ooNdj5QQvTsbIg0LeExcUybAhJk7XJ1BcWhqVh86e9Ad4YT8aWQIZhs6xJmt9mxE1XJul2zeyRYFNscu8X3oQtwloYOZPkTW18aSkKN0vsbvEutYSfRj9t92LDoKwxfGxtZ_soL6ioxD0ZeBfoStgvZ67MEVVLJiiJcvA3--Y4F-3MRDQ-FL-TQA_qTHbthG-nc%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC-YwpGuLGaWSAHNI8A_8GwLqZJhCzv8FUnosSTIyjQ38RGrrbArRVRPml7xs6sE-9-M81dFFGPusRfDvDkGt7t1zzFLApwFq6sKUI_gyukC8zaSDnCsTYx2VXK1ZeCYb0D58rJuqK14Z54SIkqktdJOJ3MLocPBnDH2xEK7gNVRssolLof1gMgshniOlrwlJDowbOlWTkYbLq1oR69KT7Hk%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC0WxMIrLpKBx_Z1nXFe8yXdMpB_dNZJWDR_LIPU0oM5TwOF2EmjemcnE5r2kzvAttIb4BWXASKEkxn7B4dLGZe8nb7_XhLs7mJxfzMax9H1JqJRzVh4o0nOl_g4nW6QNrMRGs5JUIC82Axzg9XdFUP4KNsJZg2Ph5S2mqfs_7DjJ7Hdncu6Ya5xrhfmwHkt2Tw3i3oxkYzZAE-xssArQrAU%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC8kp7qTbOGddkFCOAGr9NCb0NM1LmDB91xvBng6COnFogY2DcUC6VWqNxP48h-wA2mPlxn7D1JQkMx6L-AoJI23aB7iEA812Ppz_TLrOyzhlFZ6Sgysm9gkVCqfsuWMKw_luPS6e7sSCoIwuVXv8FYhjA_uwL0StLwDxk8szgGdbLgW-sf-X-1YqhRDL0dQ5eWbaEr58HTInU-s5iEcULac%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC3qfBJyh8VrIXOYydDOq3obvDgOmuYjLDB1nDtG0ek5Gy9my4Cdg8xzkq21PoRW98tOTf9DyVP8O5C-X4iZ579X0VYDDHRIXUpFEm1idXPLJQwQ2ML63Gv6g9Z7FDJl1Vio8BiXlp9r5HTugYnjwlfUBNM68hliDLtM0anzGALLmVnFXOVTc-W9sNKLP2Rvv2PfM61HG5N6dsyyhet20aHI%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC0oikCeFypFzMcXI0Emk3_U2mZAfO-NqtbiR6uWzu4QHjvkFTz7o2xVXxUMVRlzT6duneqhVf9Y1D05ttiAERH0krVL-Cmx08-dC0LgXDAvLSJJUq11asenSVKm1pgN3Ni6JS0hhcLnecSjvMrBkjvIp9V6FJ7OmyW71a_oYbXQLlRj64nLwJjoFp7i89IUPDsbyhmgQtmWJHQUNCBFN2Bc%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=42996f0ceb1342abb8794bfb01d5b8c4&_e=GZJ9ozadTEQHdxgNffdsOMIaNPof5BWFwwTS_qMx7KBopIAYMuUaYWycHUTQQ-tWuZJUHmta-zMmvXwg6DMai65zqJN8JdgHDdeoGLTsziH4z8y0wNThVpP-f2dVEWeNhkR2b8MPT0mogfEuR2ruC3CVliMCmpRgVMyzOJme-z6ByspvpQbZFfTJsEnfiYSaaADElikkr_ioBDmfQP8xkDlRdIj8t8ONQX4Zqi5o-y7a1KRtz6N5CKlrQyc2mfzdFoke3Ydn0sgoCcSr2D20NbCM1yiFDdR-KVinFUxRm2s5LTjHNCBO9qXQZIz29TDW52NSdhulZEh5W6rljUmpn9nmSDWr-Of4p6RFnM6M62s%3D)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. clean_body: This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. ---
Peter,

For the first time in Georgia's history, both Democrats and Republicans have nominated a Black man for the U.S. Senate.

This is indeed historic and speaks to the greatness of America's experiment with democracy. Less than 70 years ago, people like Senator Raphael Warnock and me were not able to attend the same schools as white children.

Now, we're running against one another - two Black men - in what is shaping up to be the most competitive Senate race of the entire 2022 midterm elections. Fox News has even gone so far as to say, _**"The U.S. Senate race in Georgia is key for determining control of the upper house next year."**_

**That may be where the similarities end.**

If you've read recent emails from my campaign, you'll recall that a far-Left columnist - and a regular guest on MSNBC - has trained his fire on me. Since April, he has lobbed multiple racial epithets against me that are offensive to me personally and to the entire Black community.

In the past, he said:

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_
---

and
_**"I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (I.E. HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_
---

This week, he went on MSNBC and lobbed his most disgusting attack yet: _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their Negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

**Shame on him for saying it, and shame on MSNBC for airing it.**

Despite these racially based insults making national news, Senator Warnock has said nothing.

clean_body: Shame on him for saying it, and shame on MSNBC for airing it. | Peter, For the first time in Georgia's history, both Democrats and Republicans have nominated a Black man for the U.S. Senate. This is indeed historic and speaks to the greatness of America's experiment with democracy. Less than 70 years ago, people like Senator Raphael Warnock and me were not able to attend the same schools as white children. Now, we're running against one another - two Black men - in what is shaping up to be the most competitive Senate race of the entire 2022 midterm elections. Fox News has even gone so far as to say, "The U.S. Senate race in Georgia is key for determining control of the upper house next year." That may be where the similarities end. If you've read recent emails from my campaign, you'll recall that a far-Left columnist - and a regular guest on MSNBC - has trained his fire on me. Since April, he has lobbed multiple racial epithets against me that are offensive to me personally and to the entire Black community. In the past, he said: | "Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people." and "I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (I.E. HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." This week, he went on MSNBC and lobbed his most disgusting attack yet: "Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their Negroes: to do what they're told." Shame on him for saying it, and shame on MSNBC for airing it. Despite these racially based insults making national news, Senator Warnock has said nothing. Unfortunately, Senator Warnock's silence is deafening. It puzzles me that Senator Warnock has failed to condemn any of the overtly racist attacks or that he has failed to condemn MSNBC for giving this racial commentator a platform. In fact, it also puzzles me why Senator Warnock continues to give interviews on MSNBC despite the racist attacks they air against me. Thank you for standing with me. name: American Action News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc0m82ugoqcos5rke1uk6l2gpd2sv7lb7o63vi2g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2utgrepr1euqm0plnm9q73c3jcur33cll6pgrec9kmhpbecj3m4qefdbl6uprddtnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shhcpon5cr46ur62phim2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5cjjmcpb0chie49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi1sej36o1lp5io84gtfbofr88o1eqgvflngvvhg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4stj6ao34cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn80lilgo2qo1qvp0jcb0rh1srlcpcl1kis42hso_rp22sh2s8i66pb4stj6ao34cjh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. I realized that I needed to run for office to help as many children and working families as I can
| | |
---
Friend: It's important for me to share my story with you about why I'm running and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read.
**Back when I was a social worker, I met a young boy who was being seriously neglected at home.** He needed immediate support – but I was told it would be weeks before he could be evaluated. I didn't think he would make it until then, so I went around the red tape and got him the help he needed. I was reprimanded, but that's what it took to save his life.

I remember being so angry that the system designed to help children like him had totally failed him. **That's when I heard that the Orlando Police Department was recruiting, and I took a call to protect and serve my community, to help people like that young boy.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48844564/359798557/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3974-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjMGVjMy0wNTE1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qC_s-SXjxuXRdJXXtpXhWYnL1WpcksZF1GAeg3WeixU=)
Fast-forward 27 years: I was Orlando's first woman chief of police and worked tirelessly so children like that young boy I'd met as a social worker didn't have to live in fear of playing in the streets. In my last days as chief, Mayor Buddy Dyer sat me down for a chat:
**"You have to run for Congress," he told me.**

Me? A politician? I never thought of myself that way. I even laughed.
But, as I let the idea sink in, I thought about that young boy I helped as a social worker – we were still in touch three decades later. I knew he wasn’t the only one who had to overcome hardship in his childhood: 1 in 7 kids in the U.S. lives in poverty. If I could do something to help kids like him, wouldn’t it be wrong to pass up the opportunity?

That’s when I realized that I needed to run for office to help as many children and working families as I could – so that in the next generation, more children from Florida could grow up with an incredible story of opportunity like mine. Ever since then, I’ve never stopped fighting toward that goal.
**[I'll never tire of an opportunity to do good and to serve the most vulnerable members of my community, and I'm asking you to do the same. Pitch in a contribution of $5 or more now to help send me to the Senate and continue my work of building a better future for our children.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48844565/359798558/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3974-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjMGVjMy0wNTE1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qC_s-SXjxuXRdJXXtpXhWYnL1WpcksZF1GAeg3WeixU=)**
Not a day goes by that I don't think about that child – or all of the working families who are counting on leaders like me to help them get through dark times. To thrive and not just survive.
**For me, that's what this is all about – and it's why I believe the Senate is where I can do the most good. If I win this race, Democrats can expand our Senate majority. We'll be able to extend the enhanced Child Tax Credit that's cut child poverty by more than 40%. We'll protect children from gun violence. And we'll help families keep food on the table by making groceries and gas more affordable.**
[**That's the long and short of why I'm in this race, friend. If you're ready to help me build a better future, will you donate to my campaign today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48844566/359798559/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3974-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjMGVjMy0wNTE1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qC_s-SXjxuXRdJXXtpXhWYnL1WpcksZF1GAeg3WeixU=)

Thanks for reading my story,

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Republicans Care! Volunteer Opportunity August 20
body:
Hello Team Geels!
While door knocking in Alamance County last week, Courtney met a leader in the community and struck up a conversation with him. He shared about the community doing a Backpack Drive. So Courtney stepped up to the plate and said she wanted to join his effort and bring volunteers. _He was shocked and very surprised that a Republican wanted to help out!_

We now have an opportunity to not only help a low income community in Burlington stuffing 50 backpacks with necessary school supplies, but also to let that community know that we care about all people! **The goal is to get 50 of every item on the list (or 50 packs).** What do you need to do?****
* **Commit to purchasing a specific amount of item(s)** **from the list** **ASAP and email me ****
* Buy the items you committed to
* Show up at the event wearing your Courtney Geels shirt and help the community serve the underrescourced kids.
* If you cannot attend the event but still want to help, you can drop off your supplies at my house (Orange County) or Corrie's house (Alamance County) prior to August 20. Contact either one of us for our address.

Laurie: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Corrie: [corrieshep@gmail.com](mailto:corrieshep@gmail.com)

****I 'm keeping a count of the items we commit to purchasing so it's important to let me know what you plan to buy.** All the backpacks are already purchased.

3 ring binders
No. 2 pencils
colored pencils
pencil sharpener
erasers
pens
markers
glue in the bottle
glue sticks
crayons
index cards
subject book wide
notebook paper wide rule
safety scissors

Date: Saturday, August 20
Time: 1:00pm-4:00pm
Place: 642 S. Mebane St in Burlington
__
__
__Let 's show our true colors that Republicans do care and at the same time get Courtney Geels name out there being active in different communities!__
__
__
**RSVP: Please respond back that yes, you will participate in purchasing supplies and help out at the event OR yes, you will participate in purchasing supplies and will drop off supplies at Corrie 's or my house. Remember to email me your commitment ASAP.**
**
**
**DURHAM COUNTY VOLUNTEERS:**
August 20 is also Door Knocking in Durham County from 8:45am-12:30. We need you there! Some of you might want to do both! If you are choosing one or the other, please consider door knocking a higher priority!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

I couldn’t have made it this far without the unrelenting support of grassroots patriots like yourself, but our fight is far from over.

| | | Howdy Friend, its South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem!

As an unapologetic Conservative, the Fake News media has said a lot about me these last few years, but now I’m ready to set the record straight and tell my story in my own words.

There's still hope for progressives, but time is running out before the midterm elections in November.
| | | [](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=14f4e35b45&e=007b353608)

Team,

Although we didn’t get the election results we had hoped for in Tuesday’s Ohio primaries, **__we are far from discouraged.

__** **The very nature of what we do at B/E has always been about more than simply winning elections.** Women, low-income, rural, BIPOC, and other marginalized communities are disproportionately underrepresented in our government. And yet, these are the individuals who are often most affected by policy that is currently being controlled by out-of-touch privileged politicians.

**It seems simple enough: We should have working-class representatives to represent the working-class. **_But unfortunately, the Democratic political space isn’t there yet.

_ **That’s exactly why B/E exists.** We know that bold working-class changemakers are out there and have what it takes to make a difference in public office, but they lack the political and financial advantages, which creates barriers and discourages them from even running.

By providing these bold members of our community with necessary resources and support, B/E helps our candidates break these socioeconomic barriers and works to dismantle the political system designed to hold them back.

**So regardless of our victories or losses, we consider every race we have worked on to be a success. Each of our candidates has shown the courage to challenge the status quo, even when the odds are stacked against them. They've broken new ground and have had lasting impacts on advancing critical progressive causes.**

**_This is just the beginning. The fight isn’t over yet, and we can’t give up hope for working-class progressives._**

We have at least one more competitive race coming up: After helping **Angie Jackson** win her judicial primary, she’s now on to the general election to become the next common pleas judge in Montgomery County, OH. _**_AND_**_ we hope to empower even more working-class candidates before then, too.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=618%2E5257348%2EtAbc0a ]Adam Schiff for Congress

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220805_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=618%2E5257348%2EtAbc0a ][IMG]

Derek — For 17 years, the gun industry has had blanket
protections from civil liability under the Protection of Lawful Commerce
in Arms Act (PLCAA). Put in lay terms, it means gun dealers and
manufacturers are immune from lawsuits, and victims can’t sue them in
court.

This unique immunity is like no other in our nation. Quite frankly, it’s
absurd. Car manufacturers, food producers, and tobacco companies all have
to meet a safety standard and act with due care — or else they run the
risk of being sued.

So why are guns any different? Because some politicians, for decades,
prioritized profits over people. That’s why they’ve bent over backwards to
protect the NRA and any other gun lobbyist who will write them a campaign
check or endorse them in exchange for legislation PLCAA.

It’s inexcusable, and as a result, we’ve endured a seemingly endless
stream of mass shootings and the everyday gun violence the news headlines
miss that take the lives of our friends, our family, our children, and our
neighbors. With zero accountability. Or justice for families.

Five of the largest gun manufacturers made over one billion dollars in the
last decade from selling assault-style weapons to civilians. While our
nation’s bloodshed has increased exponentially, their profits have also
skyrocketed, and yet the industry has complete legal immunity from civil
lawsuits by victims and families even when their negligence contributes to
the problem, all because of PLCAA.

That must change, and it’s why I have repeatedly introduced legislation to
repeal PLCAA, the Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act.

The NRA is already attacking me and working to prevent this bill from
passing, which is why I’m reaching out. Keeping our Democratic House
majority is critical to ensuring this legislation not only gets passed,
but makes it to President Biden’s desk.

With that in mind, I’m humbly asking:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220805_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=618%2E5257348%2EtAbc0a ]Can you pitch in $10 today to help us respond to the gun lobby’s
attacks, defeat NRA-backed Republicans, and protect our Democratic
majority? Too much is at stake to fall short.

donation will go through immediately:
